facts.fact: IXPN, established 2006, is a neutral exchange where ISPs, operators, content providers and data centres exchange traffic locally; TechTV Network reports IXPN says it is trusted by more than 130 networks, with several points of presence in Lagos data centres.

IXPN has regional connectivity in Abuja and Enugu as well as multiple points of presence in Lagos, per TechTV Network; Digital Realty announced a new IXPN point of presence at its Ibeju-Lekki data centre in April 2026 (Lagos).

systems.tiers: ISPs, telecom operators, content providers, data centres
